explication: Syrtis is a local-first macOS menu-bar monitor that reads AI coding-tool usage, derives usage and quota summaries, and presents them in a dashboard and menu-bar indicators. The main workflow runs from the user opening the status item through refresh and Rust-backed aggregation into Swift dashboard views. The README documents broad reporting, quota, chart, settings, and update capabilities; their exact internal wiring is not fully sampled, so subsystem-level links are limited to documented behavior. Rust source paths and the Swift FFI bridge implementation are not sampled.
